minimal_deficiency_lemma_proof: Let S be inclusion-minimal with |N(S)|<|S|. For c in S, minimality gives |N(S\{c})|>=|S|-1. Since N(S\{c}) is contained in N(S) and |N(S)|<=|S|-1, both have size |S|-1 and are equal. Hence |N(S)|=|S|-1 and deletion of any colour leaves the same token neighbourhood.
